scope: straightforward private representation and source cleanups; no format expansion
baseline_note: Exact pre-step working tree including earlier uncommitted selection work, not Git HEAD

runtime_conditions.build: Release -O3, core-only isolated fixture, 2 compilation jobs
runtime_conditions.includes: equal input vector copies, shape construction, acquisition/destruction, pointer/shape/edge-content checks
runtime_conditions.excludes: fixture seed generation, output, allocation counters during timing
runtime_conditions.counter_scope: ordinary throwing C++ new/new[] and delete/delete[]; excludes aligned allocations, malloc and process memory
runtime_conditions.limits: Unicode-heavy runtime and whole-dataset/storage speed unmeasured; no general speedup or compiler portability claim

build_guard.limit: one cold build and two consumer edits per version; caches not cleared; small timing differences are not speed claims

tests.limits: Full python_storage main and unrelated compiler/configuration campaigns not rerun

timeout_disposition: Combined rich and boundary Python checks were each stopped once at 30 s; independent format/source cases then passed without reducing fixture sizes or geometry. No performance probe timed out.

workflow.observation: Project Control returned attention_required/native_operation_rejected and inspect-only access; task sheet empty. Authority preserved; no native acceptance claimed.
